h1.title: Bumpy · Liked you · H1a Proof of real
h1.heading: H1a · Proof of real
h1.lead: Every reaction stays blurred, as in the brief, but each card can be checked: country flag, Verified, the reaction type (♥ / 👋) and a labelled status. The push names the country and opens that person; the paywall repeats the real counts and the country mix. Gold is still the only way to see who it is.
h1.panel_html:
Hypothesis

Problem. A free user can neither check a reaction nor answer it, so interest is lost and Gold looks like a gamble. H1 answers “check”.

If every blurred reaction shows the sender’s country flag, Verified, the reaction type and a labelled status (Online / Active today) only when true, the push opens that person’s preview, and the paywall shows real counts and the country mix,

then more Liked you openers will open the paywall and buy Gold, 7-day cancellations and refunds will go down, and fake-profile reports will not rise,

because today a reaction can’t be checked before paying (“I think they are bots to make me pay”), users ask for the country, and 34% of reactions come from abroad.

Primary: openers who open the paywall (today 3.1%). Secondary: Gold per opener (≈0.28%); 7-day cancellations and refunds. Guardrails: fake-profile reports; revenue per opener; share of cross-country Bumps.

h1b.title: Bumpy · Liked you · H1b Proof of real + age
h1b.heading: H1b · Proof of real + age (arm B of H1)
h1b.lead: Everything in H1a plus the age, before paying: “•••• 36” on every blurred card, the age in the preview sheet and in the push, and the age range on the paywall (“Aged 26–36”). H1a and H1b run against the same control, so the effect of age is measured on its own.
h1b.panel_html:
Hypothesis

Problem. A free user can neither check a reaction nor answer it, so interest is lost and Gold looks like a gamble. Arm B of H1: the same “check”, plus the age.

If on top of H1a every blurred reaction shows the sender’s age next to the hidden name, the push names the age, and the paywall shows the age range,

then paywall-to-purchase and Gold per opener will be higher than in H1a, and 7-day cancellations and refunds lower,

because age is one of the first filters in dating, and many reactions come from outside the age range the user wants; today they learn it only after paying.

Test: three arms — control, H1a, H1b; about 50% more openers than a two-arm test. Guardrails as in H1a; the city stays hidden until Gold.

h2.title: Bumpy · Liked you · H2 Free reply
h2.heading: H2 · Free reply
h2.lead: The control from the brief plus one change: a Hello back pill on every blurred card, one free use a day. The tap makes a Bump and reveals both people; then the pills disappear until tomorrow. A card tap (or the push) opens a preview with the same free Hello back or Gold; See who liked you opens the paywall, as in control.
h2.panel_html:
Hypothesis

Problem. A free user can neither check a reaction nor answer it, so interest is lost and Gold looks like a gamble. H2 answers “answer”.

If a free user can say Hello back to one blurred reaction a day, judging by the signals the card already shows, and the Bump reveals both people,

then fewer users with reactions will reply to none (today 41%) and more openers will get a Bump within 7 days, while Gold purchases and revenue per opener stay within the agreed margin,

because today a free user can’t answer a reaction at all: every tap opens the paywall, and only 9% of paywall viewers buy. A soft Hello does not need a face.

Primary: openers with ≥1 Bump from an incoming reaction within 7 days. Guardrails: Gold per opener (≈0.28%); revenue per opener; Bumps undone and reports per 100 Bumps.

screens.title: H2-01 · Push (as control)
screens.note: “Someone liked you”, as in the brief. Tap → splash → that person’s preview over Liked you (free Hello back or Gold).

screens.title: H2-01b · Splash screen
screens.note: Splash after tapping the push, 1 s, then the preview of the person who reacted.

screens.title: H2-02 · Liked you · Hello back on every card
screens.note: Say Hello back on every blurred card, 1 free a day. It answers a reaction that already exists, so it always makes a Bump. Say Hello back → confirm → It’s a BUMP · card / See who liked you → paywall (as control).

screens.title: H2-02b · Use today’s free Hello back?
screens.note: One clear step before the free reply. Hello back is the reaction itself, so the sheet says what happens: both see each other, it’s a Bump, the next free one comes tomorrow. Say Hello back → It’s a BUMP · Not now / tap outside → Liked you.

screens.title: H2-02c · Preview · free Hello back or Gold
screens.note: A tap on the card: two ways forward. Only the control signals (shared interest, Verified, the green dot), so H2 stays isolated from H1. Say Hello back · 1 free today → It’s a BUMP · See profile with Gold → paywall → this profile · X → Liked you.

screens.note: Today’s Hello back is used: Ayesha leaves, the count updates, the Chats tab gets a dot. The pills disappear until tomorrow; the header says Gold lets you answer everyone now.
